subsidies.scheme_name: Jal Shakti Abhiyan: Catch the Rain
subsidies.details: A nationwide campaign promoting rainwater harvesting and groundwater recharge through convergence with schemes like MGNREGA and PMKSY.
subsidies.benefits: Project-based funding; typically covers 50% to 100% of costs for rural and community water conservation structures.

subsidies.scheme_name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) – Per Drop More Crop
subsidies.details: Provides financial assistance for farm ponds, rainwater harvesting structures, and micro-irrigation systems.
subsidies.benefits: Up to ₹52,000 for farm ponds; additional subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
subsidies.target: Farmers (priority to small, marginal, and SC/ST farmers)

subsidies.details: Supports construction of rainwater harvesting structures such as check dams, recharge pits, and farm ponds through rural employment programs.
subsidies.benefits: Labour cost coverage and partial material cost support.

subsidies.details: Financial assistance for constructing plastic-lined or masonry farm ponds for rainwater storage and irrigation.
subsidies.benefits: 70% to 90% subsidy up to ₹1.35 lakh depending on farmer category.

subsidies.details: Provides subsidy for rooftop rainwater harvesting in individual houses and residential complexes.
subsidies.benefits: 50% of project cost (up to ₹1,00,000 for individual houses and ₹5,00,000 for residential complexes).

subsidies.details: Community Harnessing and Harvesting Rainwater Artificially from Terrace to Aquifer (CHHATA) for urban groundwater recharge.
subsidies.benefits: Financial assistance for rooftop rainwater harvesting and groundwater recharge systems.
subsidies.target: Urban households, institutions, and apartment complexes

subsidies.scheme_name: Delhi Jal Board Rainwater Harvesting Assistance
subsidies.details: Financial assistance to RWAs and group housing societies to install rainwater harvesting systems.
subsidies.benefits: 50% of total cost or ₹50,000 (whichever is less) plus 10% rebate on water bills.
subsidies.target: RWAs and cooperative group housing societies

subsidies.details: Integrated water management scheme supporting rainwater harvesting and farm ponds for dryland farmers.
subsidies.benefits: 80% to 90% subsidy for storage tanks, farm ponds, and polythene lining.

subsidies.scheme_name: Property Tax Rebate for Rainwater Harvesting
subsidies.details: Municipal corporations provide property tax rebates for buildings equipped with approved rainwater harvesting systems.
subsidies.benefits: Approximately 5% to 6% rebate on annual property tax (varies by city).

subsidies.scheme_name: Surat Municipal Corporation Rainwater Harvesting Subsidy
subsidies.details: Partial financial support to encourage installation of rainwater harvesting recharge systems.

policies.name: Model Building Bye-Laws (MBBL) 2016 – Rainwater Harvesting
policies.details: Mandates rainwater harvesting systems in new buildings across most Indian states and Union Territories.
policies.impact: Increases compulsory adoption of rainwater harvesting in urban construction projects.
